result.summary: Implemented docs/agents/design/REQ-026.md exactly as designed -- T-24h 'Still coming?' reconfirmation and T-3h route/QR reminder jobs. No schema change (confirmed: reconfirmed_at and notification_ledger both already existed; git grep confirms no doors_at column anywhere, AC9). 1. apps/bot/src/domain/notification.ts: extended per design §1.1/§1.2. Added NotificationButton, ComposedMessage ('text'|'photo'|'skip' union), NotificationSender gains sendPhoto + send(...,buttons?), SendOutcome gains 'skipped-stale', NotificationKind's reminder_24h/reminder_3h (already-anticipated REQ-025 members) now actually used. sendLedgeredNotification's step 5 rewritten to the extended rule table literally: composeMessage's 'skip' result -> skipped-stale with NO sender call (ledger row stays committed either way, per §3.2's accepted risk, unchanged); 'text' -> sender.send(tgId,text,buttons); 'photo' -> sender.sendPhoto(tgId,photo,caption). Steps 1-4 (user lookup, blocked check, marketing opt-in check, atomic ledger INSERT) untouched. 2. apps/bot/src/scheduler/rateLimiter.ts: extended per design §1.3. sendWithRetry generalized to a SendAction ('text'|'photo') that both obey the IDENTICAL pacing/429/backoff table (not a second channel) -- 'text' builds a single-row InlineKeyboard from buttons (same shape withdraw.ts's own InlineKeyboard already produces) and calls bot.api.sendMessage; 'photo' calls bot.api.sendPhoto via `new InputFile(buffer)` (grammy requires an InputFile, not a raw Buffer, for a Buffer-sourced photo -- a build-time TypeScript error caught and fixed during this run, not silently cast around). createRateLimitedSender's returned NotificationSender now implements sendPhoto too. 3. apps/bot/src/handlers/withdraw.ts: sendPromotionNotification's composeMessage closure now returns `{kind:'text', text: }` (mechanical wrapper-shape migration only, per design §1.4) and gained an `export` keyword so reminder24h.ts's decline handler can reuse it directly. 4. apps/bot/src/domain/event.ts: added findDoorsAgendaItem(agenda) per design §3.2's table -- null for a null/no-doors-item agenda, the single doors item otherwise (validateAgenda already guarantees at most one). Lives here (not domain/reminders.ts) since it operates on the AgendaItem[] shape this file already owns. 5. apps/bot/src/domain/registration.ts: added (a) getRegistrationAdmissionAndEvent(db, registrationId) -- plain SELECT, no lock, returns {admission, eventId, userId, qrToken}|null, the at-send-time recheck read both jobs' composeMessage closures call; (b) decideReconfirmOutcome (pure, first-match-wins: not-found -> not-owner -> not-eligible(admission!=='admitted') -> reconfirmed) and reconfirmRegistration (transactional: SELECT...FOR UPDATE, decide, UPDATE reconfirmed_at ONLY -- admission is never written by this function, which is what makes AC2's 'admission UNCHANGED' true structurally -- then one writeAuditLog row, action 'registration.reconfirm'), mirroring decideWithdrawOutcome/withdrawRegistration's exact shape. 6. apps/bot/src/domain/reminders.ts (NEW, framework-free, no grammy import): selectRegistrationsForReminder24h/3h(db, evaluationTime) -- one SELECT each, joining registrations->events, filtered admission='admitted' AND status='published' AND startsAt in (evaluationTime, evaluationTime+window]. Evaluation-time-as-parameter throughout (decisions/0006) -- no SQL now()/current_timestamp anywhere. 7. apps/bot/src/scheduler/reminderJobs.ts (NEW): makeReminder24hJob/makeReminder3hJob, each a ScheduledJobDefinition whose run(evaluationTime) selects candidates then calls sendLedgeredNotification per candidate sequentially (no Promise.all fan-out, per design §5 point 2's precedent). composeReminder24h: recheck admission+event via getRegistrationAdmissionAndEvent+getEventByIdWithChapterTimezone, {kind:'skip'} on either failing, else {kind:'text', text: [prompt,title,formatDateTimeInTimezone(startsAt,...)].join('\n'), buttons: [confirm,decline]} with callbackData `reminder24h:confirm:`/`reminder24h:decline:`. composeReminder3h: same recheck, then venue lookup, findDoorsAgendaItem, caption assembly (header, title, [doors line IF doorsItem!==null], start line ALWAYS, address, yandexUrl, googleUrl -- each always present as a line, empty when no venue) via the SAME formatDateTimeInTimezone(item.at-or-startsAt, chapterTimezone, lang) call REQ-017's buildEventCardContent's agendaLines mapping uses (AC7's byte-for-byte identity is structural, not two independently-written format calls), renderCheckInQrPng(botUsername, registration's own qrToken) (REQ-024's unchanged shared renderer), {kind:'skip'} if qrToken is null (defensive). 8. apps/bot/src/handlers/reminder24h.ts (NEW): REMINDER24H_CONFIRM_PATTERN/REMINDER24H_DECLINE_PATTERN, makeReminder24hConfirmCallbackHandler (resolves actingUser, calls reconfirmRegistration, replies per outcome: reconfirmed->reminder24h.reconfirmedReply, not-owner/not-found->withdraw.refusedNotFound, not-eligible->withdraw.refusedNotEligible) and makeReminder24hDeclineCallbackHandler (calls the UNCHANGED withdrawRegistration, then the now-exported sendPromotionNotification on a promotion, replies per WithdrawOutcome exactly as withdraw.ts's own confirm handler does) -- no reimplementation of withdrawal/promotion logic anywhere in this file. 9. apps/bot/src/i18n/{types.ts,en.ts,ru.ts}: added reminder24h{prompt,confirmButton,declineButton,reconfirmedReply} and reminder3h{header,doorsLabel,startLabel} -- placeholder/minimal copy per decisions/0002, CONTENT-BA owns final wording. withdraw.confirmedReply/refusedNotEligible/refusedNotFound/refusedCheckedIn are REUSED, not duplicated, for the decline path (design §6's own note). 10. apps/bot/src/index.ts: the real sequencing fix (design §8) -- `await bot.init()` now runs BEFORE startScheduledJobs (top-level await; apps/bot's package.json has `"type":"module"`, confirmed before relying on it) and before bot.start(), so `bot.botInfo.username` is populated before either job's 'immediate first run' (runner.ts's REQ-025 rule) can fire. startScheduledJobs([]) replaced with the two real jobs at intervalMs=300000 each. Two new bot.callbackQuery registrations for REMINDER24H_CONFIRM_PATTERN/REMINDER24H_DECLINE_PATTERN alongside withdraw's existing ones. bot.start() remains the file's last call, unchanged in position. Mechanical migration of the one pre-existing call site broken by ComposedMessage/NotificationSender's new shape: apps/bot/src/domain/notification.test.ts's composeMessage closures now return `{kind:'text' as const, text: ...}` instead of a bare string, and its makeFakeSender stub gained a sendPhoto method -- REQ-025's own test suite (S10 truth table, concurrent-call race, 429-backoff) re-verified green afterward, unchanged in what it tests. All 10 ACs verified with real output against a live scratch Postgres (apps/bot/docker-compose.yml, port 55432, freshly migrated -- no new migration needed, confirming the design's own 'no schema change' claim). See evidence.commands/ac_results below, especially AC3's genuine two-process kill proof, AC5's real jsqr/pngjs QR decode, and AC7's literal string-equality assertion against buildEventCardContent's own agendaLines output. Commands run from the REPO ROOT: `npm run build` -> exit 0 (apps/web Next.js build + apps/bot tsc, both clean). `npm run lint` -> exit 0, 0 errors (apps/web: 2 pre-existing unrelated warnings; apps/bot: 0 problems). `TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://bot:bot@localhost:55432/bot npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism` (repo root, no path filter) -> 22 files / 249 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped -- up from REQ-025's confirmed 217-test baseline by exactly 32 (21 new REQ-026 tests: 4 findDoorsAgendaItem unit tests in domain/event.test.ts; 4 decideReconfirmOutcome unit tests + 4 reconfirmRegistration/getRegistrationAdmissionAndEvent DB tests in domain/registration.db.test.ts; 3 confirm/decline handler DB tests in handlers/reminder24h.test.ts (NEW); 6 job-level DB tests in scheduler/reminderJobs.db.test.ts (NEW) covering AC1/AC4/AC5/AC6/AC7/AC8/AC10 -- plus 11 pre-existing REQ-025 test mechanical migrations in domain/notification.test.ts that were already counted in the 217 baseline, so the net new count is 21 test cases, all newly added, none removed). `git status --porcelain` post-cleanup confirms no file outside apps/bot/** touched and no scratch-verify-*.ts/*.json file left behind (all deleted after use).

commands: cd apps/bot && docker compose up -d -> bot-postgres-1 started fresh; DATABASE_URL=postgres://bot:bot@localhost:55432/bot npx drizzle-kit migrate -> migrations applied successfully, no new migration file generated (confirms design's 'no schema change' claim -- notification_ledger/reconfirmed_at already existed from REQ-025/REQ-011)
npm run build (repo root) -> exit 0, apps/web Next.js build clean, apps/bot tsc clean
npm run lint (repo root) -> exit 0, apps/bot 0 problems, apps/web 2 pre-existing unrelated -element warnings only
TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://bot:bot@localhost:55432/bot npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism (repo root, full suite) -> 22 files / 249 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped

AC1 (apps/bot/src/scheduler/reminderJobs.db.test.ts, 'makeReminder24hJob -- AC1'): event exactly 24h out (evaluationTime 2026-09-01T00:00Z, event.startsAt 2026-09-02T00:00Z), 1 admitted registration -> job.run() sends exactly 1 message, buttons.length===2, callbackData exactly `reminder24h:confirm:<id>`/`reminder24h:decline:<id>`, exactly 1 notification_ledger row for (registrationId,'reminder_24h')

AC2 (apps/bot/src/handlers/reminder24h.test.ts, real grammY bot.handleUpdate dispatch, same pattern as handlers/withdraw.test.ts): 'I'll be there' callback -> registrations.reconfirmed_at set non-null, admission still 'admitted' (read back from DB), exactly 1 audit_log row action='registration.reconfirm'; a withdrawn registration's confirm tap -> refusedNotEligible reply, reconfirmed_at stays null. 'Can't make it' callback -> admission flips to 'withdrawn' (read back), the seat is freed (0 admitted rows remain for that event, confirmed via a fresh admitted-count query), 1 audit_log row action='registration.withdraw', reply text identical to /withdraw's own confirmedReply string (proves reuse, not reimplementation)

AC3 (apps/bot/scratch-verify-req026-p1.ts + -p2.ts, genuine two-process kill test, deleted after use per file-placement discipline -- pattern copied from docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-025.md's own AC1 harness): p1, a real separate `npx tsx` OS process (pid 41412, confirmed via the delivery-log line it wrote), seeded a chapter/venue/published-event(24h out)/admitted-registration fixture, called `makeReminder24hJob(db,sender,300000).run(evaluationTime).then(()=>process.exit(0))` -- the kill point strictly AFTER sender.send's file-append had already durably resolved, no code after -- exited with code 0. Independent psql read after p1's exit: exactly 1 line in the delivery-log file, exactly 1 row in notification_ledger for (registrationId,'reminder_24h'). p2, a WHOLLY SEPARATE `npx tsx` invocation opening a fresh Pool/drizzle instance (no import of or reference to p1), re-read the same registrationId from a sidecar file and ran the identical job for the identical evaluationTime -> outcome: ledgerCountBefore=1, ledgerCountAfter=1 (unchanged), delivery-log file still exactly 1 line (p2 added zero) -- exactly ONE message total across the genuine process-kill-then-restart boundary, proving the durable DB-backed UNIQUE(registration_id,kind) constraint (not an in-memory guard) is what enforces at-most-once here

AC4 (apps/bot/src/scheduler/reminderJobs.db.test.ts, 'AC4'): a registration flipped to 'withdrawn' via direct UPDATE before either job runs -> both makeReminder24hJob and makeReminder3hJob's run() send 0 messages for it (selectRegistrationsFor...'s admission='admitted' filter excludes it from selection entirely), 0 notification_ledger rows of any kind for that registrationId

AC5 (apps/bot/src/scheduler/reminderJobs.db.test.ts, 'AC5', REAL jsqr+pngjs decode -- same libraries/pattern as domain/qr.test.ts): T-3h job's composed photo caption contains the venue's exact address string and both exact yandexUrl/googleUrl strings, and the exact formatDateTimeInTimezone(startsAt,chapterTimezone,'ru') string; `PNG.sync.read(photo)` + `jsQR(...)` on the actual returned PNG buffer decodes to exactly `https://t.me/test_bot?start=ci_<that registration's own real qr_token, read back from the DB>` -- a real QR decoder proof, not an inspection of the string passed to the encoder

AC6 (apps/bot/src/scheduler/reminderJobs.db.test.ts, 'AC6/AC7/AC8' -> AC6 case): an event with one agenda doors item -> the composed T-3h caption contains BOTH the doors item's own formatDateTimeInTimezone string AND the event's startsAt formatDateTimeInTimezone string, both computed with the same chapterTimezone

AC7 (same test, same case, literal string-equality assertion): buildEventCardContent(event,venue,admittedCount,'ru') is called directly against the SAME event/doors-item fixture; its agendaLines entry for the doors item's own timeText is asserted `toBe()` (strict equality) against the independently-computed doorsText, AND the T-3h caption is asserted to `.toContain()` that exact same cardDoorsLine.timeText string -- not 'looks similar', a literal `expect(a).toBe(b)` plus a containment check against the identical string

AC8 (same test file, 'AC8' case): an event with a 2-item agenda where NEITHER item's kind is 'doors' (kinds: 'networking','close') -> the composed caption does NOT contain catalog.reminder3h.doorsLabel at all, DOES contain the startsAt-only formatDateTimeInTimezone string, and does not contain either non-doors item's own formatted time (guarded against the fixture's own times coincidentally matching startsAt)

AC9 (git grep, repo root): `git grep -n "doors_at"` returns only prose/comment mentions explaining its deliberate ABSENCE (e.g. 'No doors_at column exists anywhere (PRD 5)' in schema.ts's own comment, and design-doc/decision-record prose) -- zero occurrences as an actual column/field definition in apps/bot/src/db/schema.ts or any file under apps/bot/drizzle/; separately confirmed via `grep -rn "doorsAt\|doors_at" apps/bot/src/db/schema.ts apps/bot/drizzle/` returning only that one comment line

AC10 (apps/bot/src/scheduler/reminderJobs.db.test.ts, 'AC10'): a registration with broadcast_opt_in=false on an admitted, transactional-classified reminder_24h AND reminder_3h -- both jobs still produce a committed notification_ledger row and a sender call for that user's own registrationId (checked directly by registrationId-scoped ledger query, not merely 'a send happened somewhere' -- disambiguated from the reminder24h job's legitimately over-inclusive 24h window also catching a second, unrelated 2h-out fixture in the same run, per design §3.1's own stated 'over-inclusive by design' reasoning)

issues.title: scheduler/runner.ts's internal-logger deviation (flagged by REQ-025's own handoff as a MINOR issue for whichever requirement first ships a real job) now has real, running effect
issues.description: REQ-025's step-02-backend-dev.json already disclosed that startScheduledJobs constructs its own internal `createLogger('debug')` rather than threading through index.ts's configured logLevel, and flagged that this was inert only because REQ-025 itself passed an empty job list. REQ-026 is exactly the requirement that changes that: two real jobs now run every 5 minutes in production, and any job failure (a thrown error inside makeReminder24hJob/makeReminder3hJob's run()) is logged via runner.ts's own always-'debug'-configured logger rather than index.ts's process-wide config.logLevel. No acceptance criterion in REQ-026's scope tests log-level gating for job failures, and this run's own scope (per the design, which does not mention runner.ts as a file to change) does not authorize modifying runner.ts's signature -- carrying the finding forward rather than fixing it unrequested.
issues.recommendation: If a future requirement wants the configured logLevel honored for scheduled-job failure logs, add a logger parameter to startScheduledJobs at that point -- a small design change, not an implementation shortcut to take silently here.
